args.title: checkout-api rollback to v2.3.0 after unhealthy v2.3.1 release
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Action taken: rolled back all production regions to the most recent healthy release, v2.3.0. The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error); a retry completed the rollback for us-west and eu-west. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 in all regions with a 0.2% error rate. Follow-up needed: investigate root cause of the v2.3.1 failure and the orchestrator error that caused the partial rollback before re-attempting a v2.3.1 release.

trace.error_message: Request to create_incident timed out after 30000ms

trace.final:
Done. Summary of what I did:

1. **Diagnosed**: checkout-api v2.3.1 was unhealthy in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. The most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

2. **Rolled back to v2.3.0**: The first rollback attempt partially failed (halted after us-east due to an orchestrator error), leaving the service in a mixed state. A retry completed the rollback, and all three regions are now on v2.3.0. The service is **healthy** with a 0.2% error rate.

3. **Opened SEV2 incident**: INC-0001 was created for checkout-api documenting the v2.3.1 failure, the rollback actions (including the partial failure and retry), and follow-up items — investigating the v2.3.1 root cause and the orchestrator error before any re-release attempt. The incident creation call reported a timeout, but I verified it was successfully created (and did not page twice).
